content:
maria: Heads-up — Q3 forecasting ask for embeddings + rerank. A couple of enterprise customers signaled a 2–3x seasonal usage spike (mostly realtime embedding calls + nightly rerank batches). Need a short plan for GPU-hour needs, separate pools, and a burst strategy across us-west / us-east / eu-west.

noah: Quick sketch from current metrics: steady state today ~40 A100-hours/day for embedding realtime, ~12 A100-hours/day for rerank realtime. Nightly batch rerank is ~60 A100-hours but runs with high batch efficiency. If customers hit 2.5x, raw demand ~130 A100-hours/day peak before batching gains.

lee: Important: eu-west network egress and cross-region bandwidth are tight — we should avoid spilling heavy batch traffic into eu unless we provision extra networking. Prefer region-local batch pools + cross-region fallback only for small requests.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] 1771234590: Scheduled scaling window suggestion generated (us-west, us-east) — review required.

sanjay: For capacity math I need model footprints: are we targeting the 7B quantized variant for realtime and 13B for high-quality rerank? 7B-4bit changes throughput ~+2.2x vs fp16. That affects GPU-hour forecasts a lot. Also set p99 SLOs: realtime <=120ms, rerank online <=300ms.

kevin: Cost/ops proposal: keep realtime on dedicated pinned pool (avoid preemption), add 10 A100 equivalents in us-west and 4 in eu-west as reserved capacity for Q3 surge. Run batch rerank on spot/commodity instances (preemptible G4/spot A10s) with a job window of 2am–8am local to customer region. Add auto-prewarm for KV cache 30m before batch window. Estimated incremental committed cost ~ $35k/month for reserved A100s vs much lower if we rely on spot only.

ops-qa: Practical wins: precompute top-100 rerank candidates per customer for most tenants — that cuts realtime rerank calls by ~30%. Also gating logic: if network latency to eu crosses threshold, fall back to quantized model in-region.

noah: I ran a quick conservative projection (attached as a table in the ticket):
``
Scenario A (base): 112 A100-hours/day total
Scenario B (2x): 224 A100-hours/day total
Scenario C (2.5x peak): 280 A100-hours/day total
Batch efficiency assumptions reduce batch GPU-hours by 35% if run during low-latency windows.
```

sanjay: Can someone run a perf bench for 7B-4bit under realistic prefix lengths? I want p95/p99 token latencies and memory curves. If quantization gives us 2x throughput, we can avoid adding 50% of the reserved fleet.

maria: Action items: @noah produce a spreadsheet with per-region GPU-hour/day for three scenarios (base, 2x, 2.5x) and cost delta for reserved vs spot by EOD Friday. @lee draft routing policy: region-first, fallback to quantized model, and batch overflow rules. @sanjay run perf bench on 7B-4bit and post results. @kevin write short cost summary for reserved vs spot for leadership.

kevin: ack 

noah: ack, will add assumptions and attach to ticket #INF-842

lee: will draft policy and share in this thread when ready.

ops-qa: adding a quick checklist: prewarm KV cache, enable tracing for rerank, set telemetry for per-tenant peak spikes.

maria: Thanks — want a follow-up sync Wed to finalize numbers and decide commit level. :+1:
